item.title: San Mango d’Aquino Society 100th anniversary celebration
item.description: The San Mango d’Aquino Society of Scranton will celebrate its 100th anniversary in February. The society, located at 1258 Providence Road, incorporated in 1926 with the founding fathers and immigrants from San Mango d’Aquino, a small province in the hilltops of southern Italy, Province d’Catanzaro, Calabria. item.title: SUPER BOWL: Former Meyers, NFL star Qadry Ismail breaks down the game
item.description: Former Wilkes-Barre Meyers High School star Qadry Ismail is the only player from the Wyoming Valley to win a Super Bowl. He won his ring with the Baltimore Ravens in Super Bowl XXXV when they defeated the New York Giants, 34-7, in Tampa. Ismail also played for the Minnesota Vikings, Miami Dolphins, New Orleans Saints and Indianapolis Colts. He works as a Baltimore Ravens gameday analyst for WJZ in Baltimore. item.title: WBS PENGUINS: Howe returns from ACL tear
item.description: When Tanner Howe tore his ACL last spring during the Western Hockey League’s playoffs, the subsequent surgery meant making his professional debut this season would be put on hold. item.title: With addition of Project Green, data centers could cover 14% of Archbald
item.description: Archbald received its sixth proposal for a data center campus from Green Mountain 6 LLC to build seven buildings on nearly 271 acres of land less than a mile from Aylesworth Park.
